title: Barry says the secrecy sucks

tellings.quote: "Holy cow. Can you believe this is being kept secret?" And he goes, "I it sucks. I know."

plain: Bob Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S4 in the late 1980s, tells Michels about a moment there with a colleague named Barry Castilio. Lazar says he asked him, "Holy cow. Can you believe this is being kept secret?" and Castilio answered, "It sucks. I know."
